body.prose:
Every move is a new version of the root mount, and a holon keeps its versions, so the root already has a history. Going back and forward walks it, and the browser's own back and forward are one more way of walking it, translated by the interface. A reload restores the root as it was left.

*Reasoned, the session's, 2026-11-01, answering the author's question of what a virtual history stack means; the arrangement's commits became the root's versions on 2026-11-03, as [the interface](ref:01M6JZY20ZJAAP3CBJ4KRDBXFD) tells.*
body.title: The history stack is the root's versions
